decisions.statement: A command declares the arguments the command takes rather than parsing the arguments.
One reader parses the declaration and one printer prints the declaration.
A flag carrying a value names the value and says what shape the value has.
A flag with no value names no value label.
The words reaching a command and the code the command loads are one entry.
A command page has this declaration as data rather than as prose.

definition: the shapes a command and the dispatcher reaching it share
